# third_party — vendored single-header libraries

Policy: vendor only battle-tested, permissively licensed single-header libs; record
upstream source, version and license here.

| Library | Version | License | When | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| cpp-httplib | (to vendor in Phase 2) | MIT | Phase 2 (web server) | https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib |

Optional C++ test framework: none — we use the embedded minimal harness in `tests/`.
